declaredTags.owner: search/GPL ranking owners (LambdaMartBenchmarkTest); app-services power owners (EnergyStatePollerTest); app-engine (EngineExtractionSandboxChaosTest is the sibling stress tag)
declaredTags.reason: Tests whose assertion is a claim about the MACHINE rather than about the code - wall-clock latency, or that a background thread made progress inside a window. A concurrent build on the same host fails them without the measured code changing, so a failure of this shape says nothing about the subject. Two subjects under this tag, each with the same evidence: LambdaMartBenchmarkTest p50 (four failures in one session under a sibling-worktree Gradle build, green on every isolated re-run) and EnergyStatePollerTest restartability (three failures, every one under concurrent load, green on every isolated re-run). Both quarantined at FULL assertion strength into their own runner rather than given a looser threshold: widening the budget hides the instrument limit instead of naming it.
declaredTags.cadence: local, on an otherwise idle machine, before changing scoring/inference hot paths
